title: Technology Sector Update for 09/10/2018: SAIC,ENG,I,SNAP
text:

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising over 0.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Science Applications International Corp ( SAIC ) tumbled Monday, sinking 11% in recent trading, after announcing its $2.5 billion, all-stock buyout of Englilty Holdings ( EGL ), swapping 0.45 of a share of its common stock for each Engility share. The acquisition upstaged better-than-expected Q2 financial results, with the technology integrator earning $1.13 per share during the three months ended July 31 on $1.12 billion in revenue. Analysts, on average, had been expecting the company to earn $0.99 per share on $1.11 billion in revenue.
In other sector news:
(+) Intelsat ( I ) rose as much as 3% on Monday after the satellite services company began a $1.69 billion cash tender offer for all of its 7.25% senior notes due 2020, paying an extra $36.25 in interest for each $1,000 of principal amount of the notes accrued prior to the Oct. 15 settlement date. The offer is scheduled to expire at 5 pm ET Friday, Sept. 14, unless extended or terminated early.
(-) Snap ( SNAP ) droped over 2% on Monday, falling to within 4 cents of its 52-week low of $9.62 a share after saying in a regulatory filing that chief strategy officer Imran Khan is leaving the company to pursue other opportunities. Khan is expected to remain in his current role on an interim basis to assist with the transition of his responsibilities to coworkers. His last day on the job has not yet been determined, the company said.
